6.title: Estimate Study Time: multiply integer values
6.description: Implement `totalMinutes(int lessonCount, int minutesPerLesson)` and return the product. For three lessons that each take 15 minutes, the total should be 45.
6.learningObjective: Use integer parameters and a return value to calculate a simple total duration.
instructions: Declare a static method that returns int.
Accept lessonCount and minutesPerLesson as int parameters.
Return their product with the multiplication operator.

workedExample.explanation: Integer multiplication returns the total number of minutes when both values use the same unit.

6.hint: A method can calculate a result and return it to its caller instead of printing inside the method.
6.explanation: Integer multiplication returns the total number of minutes when both values use the same unit.

testCases.description: Do not print from inside the helper method.
